sentences.en: In Switzerland, you can buy rubbers from a vending machine.
sentences.zh: 在瑞士，你可以从自动售货机上买到橡皮。

sentences.en: Rubber is made from the sap of the rubber tree.
sentences.zh: 橡胶是由橡胶树的乳汁制成的。

sentences.en: Chewing gum is a sweet which is made of rubber.
sentences.zh: 口香糖是一种由胶基（类似于橡胶）制成的糖果。
